prompt: Which correctly counts how many elements in a Shape[] are Circle instances?
choices: int count = 0; for (Shape s : shapes) if (s.name().equals("Circle")) count++;
int count = 0; for (Shape s : shapes) if (s instanceof Circle) count++;
explanation: Both B and C work; B is the classic idiomatic approach. instanceof checks if the object is of type Circle or a subclass. Option A relies on the name string matching exactly — fragile if the name changes. Option D counts all shapes, not just circles.
